summary: A Canadian AP Calculus AB workbook of about 505 pages in six chapters, from a precalculus review through limits, derivatives and their applications, integration, and applications of the definite integral, ending with slope fields and separable differential equations. Each topic gives a short concept summary and guided examples, then graded practice. The publisher cites more than 350 guided examples and full worked solutions at the back.

notes: The copyright page in the publisher's sample (ISBN 978-0-9916987-7-6, the work-list ISBN) dates this as the 4th edition, copyright 2019; the work list's 2022 date is probably a later printing of the same edition. Sections are unnumbered, so labels give the starting page from the book's contents. Worked solutions start on p. 384 (Chapter 1) through p. 479 (Chapter 6). The book is a practice workbook with brief concept summaries, not a full textbook. It includes L'Hôpital's Rule, inverse-function derivatives, and cylindrical shells, which go slightly beyond the AP AB core. Section descriptions are from general knowledge of the topics.
